text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"You can share Confidential information with a third party only after the data owner approves it and the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Sharing Confidential information, including confidential customer information, with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed."},{"text":"A third party must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"A third party must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information."},{"text":"A Data Processing Agreement must be signed before sharing begins.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"A Data Processing Agreement must be signed before sharing begins."},{"text":"Information must be transferred using the company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"Information must be transferred using the company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
